subject: Board brief: ops playbook & ask prioritization
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft ops playbook + asks for board brief

Team — attaching a working draft of the board brief (v0.9) and the Q3 metrics appendix. Goal: lock top-line story and the set of asks we want the board to sign off on by EOD Friday.

Quick context: Oak Ridge asked for a short, operational playbook that shows how we’ll deliver next-quarter throughput improvements, the mitigations for recent latency regressions, and a prioritized list of asks (budget + hires + infra). I sketched the ops playbook on slide 8 and the ask table on slide 12.

Asks:
- Monica: can you validate the rollout timeline and call out any dependencies we need legal to sign?
- Neha: will you put a 1-paragraph risk note next to each ask (I put placeholders in risk-ask-triage.md).
- Rishi: can you sanity-check the Q3 KPI numbers in the appendix?

If we can get these in by Thursday morning I’ll run a dry-run with Jonas on Thursday afternoon.

Attachments: board_brief_v0.9.pptx, Q3_metrics_appendix.xlsx, risk-ask-triage.md

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Investor Relations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft ops playbook + asks for board brief

Thanks Marissa — quick read done. High level: story is strong, but two operational edits before Neha writes the risk blurbs:

1) Slide 8 timeline: the "staged quantization" milestone currently shows Nov 15. That’s optimistic for our Dedicated rollout — revise to Nov 30 and note the rollback plan if perf drops.
2) Slide 12 ask table: move the "3 FTE SREs" ask to a tiered ask (1 x immediate hire + 2 conditional hires tied to throughput SLA). That makes it easier to get initial approval without full budget commit.

I’ll update the deck with those two edits and upload v0.91 to Drive by noon. Neha — once I push the revisions, can you slot in the risk paragraphs? Rishi — quick check on the appendix numbers would be great (especially token-unit cost change line).

Also looping in Sarah Lee from Oak Ridge so the customer/legal lens is visible — Sarah, quick heads up that we’re preparing the ops playbook and ask table for the board. I’ll share the v0.91 link when ready.

—Monica
Monica Patel
VP, Customer Success & Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft ops playbook + asks for board brief

Monica — thanks. I reviewed the placeholders in risk-ask-triage.md and drafted short notes: one-liners per ask (operational risk, mitigation, and residual risk). Highlights:

- Quantization rollout: residual risk around 95th percentile latency spikes — mitigation is staged canary + immediate fallback to float variant.
- SRE hires: hiring timeline constrained by relocation; propose contracting a temp SRE for Q1 as bridge.
- Budget ask for Dedicated capacity: call out committed utilization threshold that triggers the additional capacity purchase.

I uploaded risk-ask-triage.md (v0.2) to the Drive link and copied the paragraphs into the notes for slides 8 and 12. Small ask: can Rishi confirm the throughput numbers in the appendix so the residual risk percentages align with actual delta?

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Program Management (Strategy & Ops)
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft ops playbook + asks for board brief

Neha/Monica — checked appendix. A few notes:
- Q3 token cost line: I updated the spreadsheet formula; the change comes from a one-off cloud egress credit we received in Sept. Net impact is ~3.2% lower than originally listed.
- Throughput: the baseline is correct but the projected incremental throughput from the kernel optimizations assumes sequence length of 512; we should call that out in a footnote.
- I flagged a small mismatch in the SLA table (slide 11) where p99 latency should read 420ms (not 240ms).

I pushed Q3_metrics_appendix.xlsx v1.1 to Drive. If you want, I can join the dry-run Thursday to answer technical Qs.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft ops playbook + asks for board brief

Appreciate the fast turnaround — read the updates. A couple of editorial asks before dry-run:

- Simplify slide 8: make the timeline a two-row view ("Customer impact" and "Operational action") so the board can scan quickly.
- On the ask table, convert the tiered hires into a single-row summary with a link to a one-pager for escalation details (we can attach that to the board packet).

Monica — run the dry-run at 3:30pm Thursday and include a 10-minute Q&A with Rishi. Marissa — please keep the intro to 3 slides: context, topline ask, and the ops + risk summary.

Jonas Weber
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

Quick agenda for the 3:30pm dry-run:
- 3:30 — 3:33: Marissa intro (3 slides)
- 3:33 — 3:45: Ops playbook walkthrough (Neha + Monica)
- 3:45 — 3:55: KPI appendix & technical Qs (Rishi)
- 3:55 — 4:00: Decisions & next steps (Jonas)

Sarah — if you want to drop in for the last 10 minutes we can cover the legal sign-off language; otherwise we’ll send the finalized packet by Friday 11:00am for your review.

Attachments: board_brief_v0.91.pptx (uploaded to Drive), risk-ask-triage.md (v0.2)
